name: Young Adult Services
what_you_do: Get help finding a job, plus resume and interview workshops. Some young adults can get paid work experience, help paying for job training, or help with first-semester college costs.
who_can_apply: Youth@Work is for ages 14 to 24 who live in LA County and have the right to work in the U.S. Other help is for ages 16 to 24 with a barrier, like low income, foster care, no home, being a parent or a disability.
pay_detail: Work experience is paid, up to 200 hours. Youth@Work has 140 hours of work experience. The rate is not stated.
duration: Up to 200 hours of work experience. Youth@Work: 20 hours of training and 140 hours of work.
deadline_text: No program dates are listed as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the Get Started Today form on the page, or call (562) 402-9336 or (800) 481-6555.
notes: Call first to check what is running. The page's latest copyright year is 2022, and it does not say if you can join while still in school. Youth@Work gives priority to groups such as foster youth, homeless youth and LGBTQ youth.
